sources.title: Privacy Notice
facts: Section 12 describes usual retention of personal information for six years beginning at account closure and permits changes for business or regulatory requirements.
Sections 18 and 19 discuss consent withdrawal and erasure requests, including possible legal reasons preventing erasure.
The wording does not establish that every chat remains for exactly six years, that data is available as a recoverable user archive, or that account closure instantly erases every record.
